newsitem.title: USA: FP&L St Lucie 1 nuke unit restarting Fri.
newsitem.headline: FP&L St Lucie 1 nuke unit restarting Fri.

text.p: Florida Power and Light Co's (FP&L) 839 megawatt (MW) St Lucie 1 nuclear unit was expected to restart by Friday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Thursday in its daily plant status report.
The utility also said late Wednesday that it tentatively expected the unit to restart by Friday.
"We're still troubleshooting the circuit breaker that went bad and caused the shutdown in the first place. Once we know that was indeed the cause, we'll restart," company spokesman Dale Thomas said.
The NRC had reported earlier this week that the unit, which tripped off line Tuesday, may restart Wednesday. FP&L never confirmed this.
The adjacent unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, was operating at full power.
Both units are located in Hutchinson Island, Fla.
FP&L is a unit of FPL Group Inc.
